summary.en: Settings opens on Common and shows every AI as a card; the AI chat can use your agent's MCP servers (read-only) and look at screenshots; shape codes for pinyin; what you type now shows only in the candidate box.
summary.zh: 设置打开就是「常用」，AI 都列成卡片；AI 对话可以用你的 agent 里 MCP 服务器的只读工具，也能看截图；拼音可用辅助码；正在打的内容只显示在候选框里。
